_comment_packageVersion: The Beat Saber build this mod is compiled against. Must stay in step with qpm.json's bs-cordl range (4008.0.0 == 1.40.8_7379) and bsml range. QuestPatcher compares this string against the installed game exactly; if it still warns, the version it shows is the one to put here.
description: Pop-out YouTube live chat overlay for Beat Saber, standalone on Quest. Shows chat in the menu and during levels, signs in with your YouTube account (or a plain API key), and needs no PC or companion server.
